newsitem.title: JORDAN: USDA boosts PL-480 credits to Jordan.
newsitem.headline: USDA boosts PL-480 credits to Jordan.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) granted Jordan a $21 million soft loan under the export credit programme PL-480, an official said on Monday.
A supply ministry official said the loan agreement signed in Amman on Monday would help it purchase about 100,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat from private U.S. sources.

The loan must be repaid over a 21-year span following an initial five year grace period. It has a concessionary three percent interest rate for the first five years and sets a four percent rate for the remaining period.
Jordan has been a main beneficiary of the PL-480 programme for the second year running, with a similar amount of credit extended in 1996.
